## Context / Problem
ADR 0086's cross-ticket overlap detector ships as a write-path enrichment queue: `src/rebar/_store/event_append.py:385-387` and `src/rebar/_store/push.py:590-596` call `rebar.llm.enrich_drain.maybe_drain` after every write, `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/attest.py:216-233` enqueues `ENQUEUE_ENRICH` at certification, and `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/__init__.py:600-612` runs BM25F retrieval plus an LLM judge inside `review-plan`. Each drained ticket pushed about 4 commits on the shared `tickets` branch (`rebar.toml:205-211`), starving other writers; the feature is off here (`rebar.toml:42,216`) and upstream, so 2,280 LOC plus 13 config keys, 13 env vars, a CLI verb, two prompts, two schemas and a doctor lock leg are dead surface. Because `verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets` also gates the cheap create-time journal (`src/rebar/_commands/recent_creates.py:148`), turning the detector off also turned the journal off. Operator decisions (2026-09-06): remove the implementation; keep the four event-type names so the ~105k historical events parse; keep the journal and re-enable it; no tombstones (ADR 0116, `docs/adr/0116-retire-config-aliases.md:65-68`). All cites are on origin/main 2e81cb9767c1.

## Approach
Delete the modules and their CLI, prompt, schema, and contract registrations; cut each hook out of the kept files; keep `TICKET_DIGEST`, `ENQUEUE_ENRICH`, `CLAIM_ENRICH`, `DONE_ENRICH` in `src/rebar/reducer/_version.py:53-56` (`_NON_REPLAY_KNOWN_TYPES`, consumed by `fsck_scan.py:248` and `bridge_fsck.py:115`) and `src/rebar/_store/event_prepare.py:73-80` (`EVENT_TYPES` write allowlist, so `tests/unit/test_store.py:80-86`'s drift guard holds and the regression test can append the four types through the ordinary path) with a "retired producer" comment; narrow `verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets` to the journal and flip it to `true` in `rebar.toml` in the SAME commit as the code removal (else `true` re-arms the billable overlap step at `plan_review/__init__.py:607-612`); regenerate every CI-gated artifact; add one regression test proving the four retired types still reduce, survive compaction, and fsck clean. The `[llm]` section is reserved (`src/rebar/_config_sections.py:187,201`), so a leftover `[llm] overlap_*` key is silently ignored even under `REBAR_CONFIG_UNKNOWN_KEYS=error`; the release note says so; warning on `[llm]` keys is the config epic's (needs a core-local known-key tuple in `_config_sections.py:180-183`, which must not import `rebar.llm`). `reviewers/index.json` has no digest/judge entry today. `scripts/gen_cli_help.py` `_write()` unlinks stray artifacts (`:195,229`), so regen removes `help/enrich.txt` and re-renders `overview.txt:53`. `plan_review_verdict.schema.json` never declares `overlap` (`:7`, `additionalProperties: true`): no schema or `types.py` edit.

## Scope
Delete: `src/rebar/llm/overlap/{__init__,digest_sidecar,graph,judge,queue,retrieve,wire}.py` (1,439 LOC), `src/rebar/llm/enrich.py` (206), `src/rebar/llm/enrich_drain.py` (635), `src/rebar/_cli/_parsers/advanced/enrich.py`, `src/rebar/_cli/help/enrich.txt` (via regen), `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/ticket_digest.md`, `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/overlap_judge.md`, `src/rebar/schemas/ticket_digest.schema.json`, `src/rebar/schemas/overlap_verdict.schema.json`, `scripts/overlap_judge_calibrate.py`, `docs/calibration/overlap_batch_confidence.md` and `.output.txt`; tests `tests/unit/test_enrich.py`, `test_enrich_drain.py`, `test_enrich_queue.py`, `test_overlap_judge.py`, `test_overlap_retrieve.py`, `test_plan_review_overlap.py`, `test_ticket_digest_store.py`, `tests/fixtures/enrich_quality/*.json` (6), `tests/fixtures/overlap_pairs/*.json` (13).

Edit (kept src and tests): the exact line-level list is in this ticket's first comment; the kept files are `_store/event_append.py`, `_store/push.py`, `llm/plan_review/attest.py`, `llm/plan_review/__init__.py`, `_engine_support/reads_cli.py`, `_cli/_llm_commands.py`, `_cli/_registry.py`, `_cli/__init__.py`, `llm/__init__.py`, `llm/config.py`, `llm/config_readers.py`, `llm/config_binding.py`, `llm/contracts.py`, `schemas/__init__.py`, `schemas/doctor.schema.json`, `_commands/doctor_locks.py`, `_config_schema.py`, `reducer/_version.py`, `_store/event_prepare.py`, `rebar.toml`, `scripts/probe_rebar.py`, plus 26 test files; also the prose-only sites AC2 would hit: `_proc.py:17` and `_commands/compact_trigger.py:25` docstrings, the `.rebar/criteria_routing.json` `enrich_drain*` glob row, the `_llm_drain_mode` control in `tests/unit/test_env_registry_helper_coverage.py`, and three test docstrings naming `test_enrich_drain.py` (exact lines in the 2026-10-18 comment).

Add one regression test in `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_event_schema_forward_compat.py` named `test_retired_overlap_event_types_still_parse` (assertions in this ticket's first comment) and regenerate the seven CI-gated artifacts with the command listed there; never hand-edit `.github/*-baseline.json`.

## Testing
Happy: `make verify` green; `review-plan --output json` has no `overlap` key; `show` has no `digest_freshness`; `doctor --output json` reports five lock legs; `create` twice with one title prints `duplicate_warning` (journal re-enabled). Edge: the new retired-types test (all four types on one ticket, compaction, fsck); `REBAR_CONFIG_UNKNOWN_KEYS=error rebar list` with `[llm] overlap_k = 20` in a temp `rebar.toml` exits 0 (silent-ignore, `_config_sections.py:201`); `rebar enrich` exits 2 as an unknown subcommand; `python -c "import rebar.llm; rebar.llm.enrich"` raises `AttributeError`; a box with a leftover `.rebar/enrich-drain.lock` gets no doctor finding.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `git ls-files src/rebar/llm/overlap src/rebar/llm/enrich.py src/rebar/llm/enrich_drain.py src/rebar/_cli/help/enrich.txt src/rebar/schemas/ticket_digest.schema.json src/rebar/schemas/overlap_verdict.schema.json scripts/overlap_judge_calibrate.py` prints nothing.
- [ ] `git grep -nE 'llm\.overlap|enrich_drain|_read_llm_overlap_settings|_llm_drain_mode|DEFAULT_OVERLAP_|overlap_drain|digest_freshness|REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP' -- src scripts tests rebar.toml .rebar` prints nothing; its pre-edit run (must list only deleted files plus the sites above) and post-edit run are pasted into a comment.
- [ ] `python -c "from rebar.reducer._version import _NON_REPLAY_KNOWN_TYPES as N; from rebar._store.event_prepare import EVENT_TYPES as E; assert {'TICKET_DIGEST','ENQUEUE_ENRICH','CLAIM_ENRICH','DONE_ENRICH'} <= N & E"` exits 0.
- [ ] `pytest tests/interfaces/contracts/test_event_schema_forward_compat.py -k retired_overlap -q` prints `1 passed`.
- [ ] `rebar review-plan <ticket> --output json | python -c "import json,sys; assert 'overlap' not in json.load(sys.stdin)"` exits 0 on one real ticket.
- [ ] `rebar doctor --output json | python -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert [l['name'] for l in d['locks']]==['tickets-write-fcntl','tickets-write-mkdir','hlc','compact-worker','snapshot-gc-worker']"` exits 0.
- [ ] `rebar enrich status` exits 2 with an unknown-subcommand usage error on stderr; `rebar help` output has no `enrich` line.
- [ ] `python -c "import tomllib;c=tomllib.load(open('rebar.toml','rb'));assert c['verify']['suggest_duplicate_tickets'] is True and 'overlap_drain' not in c['llm']"` exits 0, and two `rebar create task "same title"` within 600 s print `duplicate_warning` on stderr for the second (exit 0).
- [ ] Each of `python scripts/gen_cli_help.py --check`, `python scripts/gen_cli_reference.py --check`, `python scripts/gen_env_registry.py --check`, `python scripts/gen_config_reference.py --check`, `python scripts/gen_api_surface.py --check`, `python -m rebar.llm.prompting.prompts regenerate-index --check`, `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check` (reports `stale=1 new=0 increased=0`), `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` (`stale>=14 new=0`) exits 0 with no hand edit to either `.github/*-baseline.json`.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.
